lines: Drive left and right with {aim_left} and {aim_right}.
Hold {lift} to fire the thruster and climb; it also turns the drill up.
Hold a direction against the ground to bore through it.
Ore fills your cargo hold. Take it back to the platform to sell it:
stop on the Sell bay pad and Dock with {interact}.
This is the Sell bay: Sell, repair and recharge ({quick_service}) does all three.
Upgrades are bought at the Upgrade bay, along the pad.
Your money covers an upgrade. Drive along the pad to the Upgrade bay,
stop on its pad and Dock with {interact}.
Energy is your clock: get back to the pad before it runs out.
Stranded on an empty tank? Call the tow with {request_rescue}, for a fee.
afterRescueLines: The tow brought you home. You lost cargo worth {cargoLost} and paid a {fee} fee, nothing more.
Energy is your clock: get back to the pad before it runs out.

lines: Transmission from the Guild: your rig stands on the pad, prospector.
Bring up ore, buy better gear, and dig your way down to the core.
Transmission from the Guild: you have struck the core!
Haul its fragments to the platform; enough of them buys passage to the next world.
Transmission from the Guild: welcome to the second world.
Gravity pulls harder here. Mind your thruster and your energy.
